scope: Noncommutative Grothendieck and spherical spectral-rounding attack on the arbitrary-rank common-barycenter variance gate
overall_status: UNKNOWN: explicit legal rounding gives an active-rank loss; no arbitrary-rank proof or legal counterexample established

claims.exact_statement: For a legal supplied broadcaster and any positive frame dual Q=sum_i w_i |A_i><A_i| of active rank r, randomized spectral measurement of G_u=sum_i sqrt(w_i)u_i(A_i tensor I+I tensor A_i), with u uniform on S^(r-1), is a legal common POVM. The regression functions f_i(u,k)=r u_i lambda_(u,k)/(2 sqrt(w_i)) have first moment Phi(A_i).
assumptions: Phi is unital, trace-preserving, CP, and HS-self-adjoint
B is a supplied symmetric broadcaster with both output marginals Phi
claims.novelty_boundary: A legal measurement construction only; it does not close the arbitrary-rank gate.
claims.costs: Continuous randomized output PVM; finite representation follows from compact convex reduction. No acquisition, implementation, or hardware claim.
claims.falsifier: A normalization error in spherical moments or the two local adjoint restrictions invalidates the unbiased first moment.

claims.exact_statement: For the legal spectral sketch above, the exact quadratic estimator penalty is P=(r/4) sum_i w_i Tr[sigma_AB (A_i tensor I+I tensor A_i)^2], which is at most r sum_i w_i by the fixed tracial marginals and state Cauchy-Schwarz. Therefore the resulting bound is S_d(Q)>=2 Tr_HS(Q Phi)-r Tr_HS(Q), not the target with coefficient 1.
claims.status: internally derived exact penalty and valid weaker support bound; inadequate for unbounded rank
claims.novelty_boundary: Identifies the rank loss of one-random-scalar rounding; not an impossibility result for collective POVMs.
claims.falsifier: An error in the second-moment computation or the scalar inequality t^2/p>=2tf-pf^2 invalidates the bound.

claims.exact_statement: Standard noncommutative Grothendieck/Little-Grothendieck factorization statements do not directly imply the needed canonical support inequality: their state or functional factorizations must additionally be converted to one barycenter-I/d POVM on the input, legally pulled back from AB, with the quadratic negative Tr_HS(Q) correction and exact coefficient preserved.
assumptions: Target is the full-domain all-positive-Q comparison
Barycenter and all Choi marginals are part of the legal interface
claims.status: proved only as an interface distinction; no general no-go for a refined Grothendieck argument
claims.novelty_boundary: The theorem interfaces are standard; this is not a priority assessment.
claims.costs: Bounded theorem-interface source check only; no external proof review.
claims.falsifier: A derived theorem-specific upgrade yielding the legal barycentric POVM with the target coefficient would overcome this identified gap.

claims.exact_statement: The arbitrary-rank full-domain factor-two theorem and existence of a legal marginal-feasible counterexample remain unresolved by this cycle.
claims.falsifier: A complete arbitrary-rank common-barycenter proof or a legal global moment-dual counterexample changes this status.
